1.

Jesus, full of love, calls: Come to Me, thou thirsty soul! I will give life and salvation, All for thee may become well. Come to Me, come to Me, The water of life I give thee! Come to Me, come to Me, The water of life I give thee!

2.

Come to Me from the world’s tumult, From its unrest, sin, and strife! I alone to thy spirit Can give the true peace. Come to Me, come to Me, Thy sins are forgiven thee! Come to Me, come to Me, Thy sins are forgiven thee!

3.

Wouldst thou possess the kingdom of heaven, Wouldst thou receive the crown of life? Wouldst thou reach the new city And walk the golden street? Come to Me, come to Me, I have won all for thee! Come to Me, come to Me, I have won all for thee!

4.

Lord Jesus, to Thee alone Body and soul I would give. Take me as I am, O Lord, I forever belong to Thee. Praise to Thee, praise to Thee, That Thou also wilt save me! Praise to Thee, praise to Thee, That Thou also wilt save me!
